=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:Phase 3c/4b | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The bait-commit step can race the implement workflow and make the PR-update sequence flaky.
  WHY: All three reviewers identified the same timing-sensitive handoff in Phase 3c/4b, with the highest confidence coming from z-ai_glm-5.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:orchestrate-decompose-test job | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: Cleanup is not guaranteed if the orchestrate-decompose-test assertions fail, leaving orphaned resources behind.
  WHY: All three reviewers flagged the same failure-path leak, and z-ai_glm-5 rated it confidence 5.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:clarify-rejects-unsolvable-test job | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The test can leak the temporary GitHub issue if the job fails before cleanup runs.
  WHY: All three reviewers identified the same cleanup leak, and z-ai_glm-5 rated it confidence 5.
- scripts/analyze_soft_errors.py:Phase 8 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The soft-error analyzer can exceed safe context limits when the capped log slice is wrapped in prompt overhead.
  WHY: All three reviewers called out the same Phase 8 context-limit risk; z-ai_glm-5 explicitly named the script and rated it confidence 3.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:e2e-alt-model-test job | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: ALT_EDITOR_MODEL is used without validation before downstream workflow dispatch.
  WHY: All three reviewers flagged the same configuration-validation gap, with z-ai_glm-5 rating it confidence 4.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:Phase 7 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The cancel-on-PR-close test can poll too early and miss the triggered workflow run.
  WHY: All three reviewers identified the same asynchronous timing race; the highest confidence reported was 3.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:orphan-workflows-test job | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: Simultaneous dispatches can collide or hit API rate limits during the orphan-workflows test.
  WHY: All three reviewers raised the same dispatch-collision concern, though the strongest confidence was only 3.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: dry_run does not appear to guard every side effect in the new jobs.
  WHY: Reviewers disagreed on severity, ranging from medium to critical; using the highest severity critical and the highest confidence 5.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  WHY: The reviewer treated this as the most critical concern and rated it medium severity, confidence 4.

- scripts/analyze_soft_errors.py | confidence=3

- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:e2e-alt-model-test job | confidence=4

- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml | confidence=4
